
 ◇ susynth › Help · night-drive • · no audio
 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

 Pages    Help · ↑↓ PgUp PgDn scroll
 ───────  ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  1          PAGES
  2          Esc 1 … Esc 7          Play, Sets, Recordings, Sounds, Settings, Help, Perform
  3          Esc f  /  Esc b        next / previous page
  4          Esc                    from any page, back to Play
  5          Esc m                  the pages down the left: ↑↓ choose, Enter open, Esc back
  6          The numbers are down the left. Press Esc, then the key within 1.5 s, or hold Alt.
  7          F1-F7 still open those pages when the terminal sends function keys.
             KEYS ON EACH PAGE
             Sets                   ↑↓ select · Enter load · a add to the set list · n new · d delete (twi…
             Recordings             ↑↓ select · Enter show the path · d delete (twice)
             Sounds                 ↑↓ select · ←→ fold a group · Enter preview or fold · i insert the exa…
             Settings               ↑↓ select · ←→ change · Enter edit or reload where it says so
             Help                   ↑↓ PgUp PgDn scroll
             Perform                Enter go live · Esc n / Esc p next / previous · [ ] reorder · d remove

             PLAYING
             ^E                     run the block under the cursor (the whole live_loop; ┊ marks it)
             Esc Enter              run the whole buffer, like Sonic Pi's Run
             ^G                     stop every live_loop and thread, like Sonic Pi's Stop
             ^P                     stop, or run the whole buffer again
             ^R                     start / stop recording a WAV
             ^S  ^O                 save / load a set by name (sets are .rb files)
             Esc u  n               mute / unmute track n — a digit alone does nothing


  ▶ play  60 bpm  bar 1  ● ○ ○ ○  rec off               ^E run  ^G stop  ^P play  ^R rec  ^S/^O set  ^Q quit
